# Salesforce SOQL Runner Workspace Instructions

- Project type: Next.js application deployed to Vercel.
- Build with `npm run build`; run locally with `npm run dev`.
- Keep Salesforce credentials and access tokens server-side.
- Use Salesforce OAuth for authentication and the `/api/query` route for SOQL execution.
- Keep changes focused on authentication, SOQL execution, and result presentation.
- Verify the production build after source changes.
